card.name: Measurement units after a number
card.fires_on: Units of measure or the last piece of a unit or number, right after a numeric value, such as cm, kg, MBq, Hz or candela. It appears in dosing, radiation and lamp-output text.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: A unit such as cm or kg directly follows a measured value or range.

modes.label: Partway through a unit or number
modes.description: The marked piece is the middle or end of a split unit name or of a number being written out.
